title: City Writeup

steps.text: Story: “We found a file from the city terminal office. Hackers are using this file to hack into the office. Collect the secret data from the city terminal office before it ends up in the wrong hands.”

Solution: The participant is given an executable and image of Secretariat of Kerala which is situated in Trivandrum.
 While running the init_connect file, the program asks to enter the city name which is Trivandrum. Upon giving the city name, the program connects to the city server and asks for the unbreakable password.
